Board of Health - Air Quality
AirNow.gov
Residents can check current air quality by zip code.  AirNow reports air quality using the official U.S. Air Quality Index (AQI), which is color coded to indicate if the air is healthy or unhealthy.
Air Monitoring in MA
Provides daily air quality updates for MA.  Note, if there is an active alert, it will appear as a yellow banner across the top of the page.  Select "MassAir online" for current air quality and forecasts.

West Nile Virus
Dead birds are no longer being tested for WNV and do not need to be reported to the MA Department of Public Health before safe disposal in the trash.  Using gloves, a shovel or plastic bags covering your hands, the dead bird should be double-bagged and placed in the trash. You should then wash your hands. (Source, August 2020)
